platinum.note: PowerPyx rates the set 4/10 and about 200 hours: long, not hard. One playthrough is enough; there is no mission replay and no New Game+, but free roam continues after the story.

gtazone.name: GTA Zone — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies — this one pops automatically when the last one lands.
Work the roadmap in order: story first, then side content, then collectibles, then cleanup.
Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter; there is no mission replay and no New Game+.
trophies.tip: PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 and about 200 hours — long, not hard. Worth 0G on Xbox; the other 54 add up to 1,000G.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, as Jason.
Follow the on-screen prompts through the mission to its end card.
trophies.tip: Unmissable — it pops the first time you finish the opener.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Play through Chapter 1 to its final mission.
Do the meditation prompt offered at Jason's house before the chapter ends — it feeds Positive Mental Attitude, the one missable trophy.
trophies.tip: Chapter trophies are unmissable; the meditation inside Chapter 1 is not.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Finish Chapter 2, playing through its missions in order.
Both Lucia and Jason are playable from Chapter 2 — the partner trophies open up here.
trophies.tip: Keep a manual save at the chapter start; there is no mission replay.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Finish Chapter 3.
Robberies open up in Chapters 3 and 4 — start the bank-vault and armored-truck trophies when they appear.
trophies.tip: Story trophies unlock by playing; none of them can be missed.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Finish Chapter 4.
With the story nearly done, sweep any partner trophies before the finale.
trophies.tip: Make a manual save before the final mission.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Play the final mission to the end.
Make a manual save before it — there is no mission replay, so this is your last clean shot at anything chapter-gated.
trophies.tip: Worth 50G on Xbox. After the credits you return to free roam.

trophies.name: Trust
steps: Complete the mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the story.
It pops at the mission end card; nothing extra to do.
trophies.tip: Unmissable story mission trophy.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist.
Story mission — unmissable, pops on completion.
trophies.tip: Heist practice for the bank-vault robberies later.

trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Complete the mission Child's Play.
Story mission — unmissable, pops on completion.
trophies.tip: Nothing to prepare; just play the mission.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Complete the mission Headliners.
Story mission — unmissable, pops on completion.
trophies.tip: Nothing to prepare; just play the mission.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown at the airport.
Story mission — unmissable, pops on completion.
trophies.tip: The airport is also where Catch Me If You Can happens — different trophy, free-roam moment.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory.
Story mission — unmissable, pops on completion.
trophies.tip: Nothing to prepare; just play the mission.

trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: After the credits, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion to see the checklist.
You need about 60% of true completion, not everything: 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts.
Work the checklist in this guide's Phase 4 order — most of it fills in while you chase the other trophies.
trophies.tip: The hardest trophy in the set, per PowerPyx and GTABase — but the thresholds are lenient. Worth 100G on Xbox.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida.
Stunts come in four categories — mix jumps, airtime, near-misses and drifts rather than grinding one type.
The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250 if you are chasing A Long Road.
trophies.tip: A stunt counts when the on-screen prompt confirms it — failed landings do not.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
steps: Try each of the 9 activity types once: shooting range, drone races, fishing, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting, races and open-world challenges.
The tracker ticks each type off as you try it — check this guide's activity list if one will not tick.
trophies.tip: Do this early in Phase 2; it maps every activity the later trophies need.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
steps: Visit the shooting ranges and work through all 42 challenges.
Gold-medal each one — the score thresholds are shown before you start.
Replay a challenge freely until gold; ranges stay open after the story.
trophies.tip: The 100% checklist also needs the ranges done, so this is not wasted effort. Worth 40G on Xbox.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
steps: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations.
There are 42 races in total — you only need one win per location, not every race.
trophies.tip: Learn a track's corners on a first run, then push for the win on the retry.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Win 20 different races — road, off-road and street circuits all count.
Each race only counts once, so work down the list instead of replaying a favourite.
trophies.tip: Wins during the story count, so this may be half done already.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
steps: Find Cal and take him on in a fishing challenge.
Land the bigger catch before the timer ends to beat him.
trophies.tip: Fishing also feeds the activity list for Master of None.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Find an arcade cabinet and start any arcade game.
Play it through to its end — a single finished game pops the trophy.
trophies.tip: Pick the shortest game on the cabinet if you only want the trophy.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
steps: Play Andy's mission strand to its final mission.
Strand missions appear as icons on the map — clear them when they show up.
trophies.tip: Character strands are unmissable in free roam after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
steps: Play Kenton's mission strand to its final mission.
Strand missions appear as icons on the map — clear them when they show up.
trophies.tip: Character strands are unmissable in free roam after the story.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
steps: Play Billy's mission strand to its final mission.
Strand missions appear as icons on the map — clear them when they show up.
trophies.tip: Character strands are unmissable in free roam after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
steps: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida.
Stranger icons appear on the map as you explore — start each strand when you find it.
Strands can run several missions long, so clear them in the order you meet them.
trophies.tip: Counts toward the 100% checklist's side content.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
steps: Play Randy's mission strand to its final mission.
Strand missions appear as icons on the map — clear them when they show up.
trophies.tip: Character strands are unmissable in free roam after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
steps: Play Tyrone's mission strand to its final mission.
Strand missions appear as icons on the map — clear them when they show up.
trophies.tip: Character strands are unmissable in free roam after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missable_note: The Chapter 1 meditation is offered once and is gone after the chapter — the only trophy the guides flag as possibly missable.
steps: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida's 10 meditation locations.
Do the Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house the first time it is offered — PowerPyx flags this one as missable once Chapter 1 ends.
Other lists place a Chapter 1 spot on Lucia's balcony the morning after Down to Earth — take every meditation prompt you are offered in Chapter 1, whichever character offers it.
After the story, sweep the remaining spots in free roam.
trophies.tip: Keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 1. If the prompt never appeared, reload that save.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
steps: Take Bret's hunting quests and track the unique animal he asks for.
Study animals through the binoculars first — the 100% checklist wants 100 of 255 studied.
trophies.tip: Hunt quietly; spooking the animal wastes the attempt.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Collect the cards for 3 complete sets.
Cards are scattered across Leonida — check shops, hideouts and mission rewards as you go.
Trade or buy the last stragglers rather than hunting blind.
trophies.tip: Sets are per-theme; finishing one set shows your progress on the rest.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different locations.
Work through the map region by region so you do not double-count spots.
trophies.tip: The count rises per unique location — repeating a spot adds nothing.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges.
The 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops on the way to A Long Road.
Skip the hardest challenges — you have 30 to spare.
trophies.tip: Challenges cover combat, driving, exploration and minigames; play wide, not deep.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
steps: With your partner riding along, build a 4-star wanted level.
Lose the cops and escape the heat with your partner still with you.
Use the countryside and water to break line of sight, then lay low until the stars clear.
trophies.tip: Do it while both characters are together in the story — partner availability is story-gated.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
steps: With your partner, rob three shops in a row.
Keep your wanted level through all three — do not lose the cops between shops.
Plan a route of three close shops and hit them fast, one after another.
trophies.tip: If the wanted level drops, the streak resets — start the run over.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Discover 100 different vehicles.
Scan vehicles as you meet them — the 100% checklist wants 200 of 277 scanned.
Variety beats repetition: new models count, the same model twice does not.
trophies.tip: Traffic, parked cars and mission vehicles all count.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
steps: Trigger Combat Focus during a fight.
Take down 5 enemies inside a single use — pick a crowded shootout, not a duel.
Line the shots up before you trigger it; the window is short.
trophies.tip: A gang hideout beats a police shootout — more targets, less pressure.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
steps: Get to VCIA, the airport, and leave in a way that was never scheduled.
Board or steal a plane and take off without a flight plan — the game flags the departure.
Expect a wanted level on the way out; have an escape route ready.
trophies.tip: Any runway departure that skips the terminal counts as unscheduled.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Get a wanted level high enough that Rhino tanks roll in.
Deal with the Rhinos — destroy one, hijack one, or survive the encounter, and the trophy pops.
Use heavy weapons and cover; a Rhino's cannon ends a stand-up fight fast.
trophies.tip: Tanks show up at the highest wanted levels — build heat away from tight streets.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
steps: Pick a jewelry store and case it first — note the cameras, guards and exits.
Rob it without being detected: stay out of sight lines, move quietly, take the goods and leave before the alarm.
If you are spotted, leave and try another store — detection voids the attempt.
trophies.tip: Night and a quiet approach beat a loud smash-and-grab.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time.
Vaults open up in Chapters 3 and 4 — plan each job, hit the vault, then break the wanted level before the next.
Escaping is part of the trophy: a busted job does not count.
trophies.tip: Space the jobs out and restock between them; five clean escapes beat five fast ones.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
steps: Find an armored truck on the road and stop it.
Rob it, then escape the wanted level that follows.
A roadblock or a heavy vehicle makes the stop; a quiet street makes the escape.
trophies.tip: Trucks run set routes — learn one route, then hit it where the road is wide.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida.
The map fills in as you visit — chase the blank patches after the story.
Coastline, swamps and the Keys count just like the city does.
trophies.tip: Pair this with vehicle discovery and WAiNK stops on the same route.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
steps: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs.
Operations are marked as you uncover them — work gang by gang.
Each robbery raises heat with that gang, so finish one before starting the next.
trophies.tip: The 100% checklist needs every robbery done, so this feeds A Long Road too.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach and order a cocktail with a view.
Sit through the moment — the trophy pops when the scene plays out.
trophies.tip: The exact trigger is not yet pinned down by the guides; what the description asks for is a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
steps: Find a vehicle showroom and drive a car straight out through the glass, in classic style.
Expect a wanted level and a repair bill — the escape is the point.
trophies.tip: Not yet pinned down by the guides — the description points to a showroom smash-out.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Play a frame and follow through — finish the game you start.
trophies.tip: Bowling also counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.

trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Play through the partnership moments in the story until the mass-appeal one lands.
It pops on the story beat — no side requirement.
trophies.tip: Story-tied; it will come if you keep playing.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Keep making choices — dialogue picks, side-quest decisions, and how you handle encounters all feed the count.
The count behind this one runs into the hundreds, so play naturally and it fills in.
Check your stats to see the count climb.
trophies.tip: Choices cannot be unmade — but the count is cumulative, so nothing is missable here.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: Fail something, then succeed on the second try — the name says it: second time's the charm.
Try a challenge or mission beat twice in a row; the retry is what counts.
trophies.tip: Exact trigger not yet pinned down by the guides.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: Explore the strange corners of Leonida — the trophy is for witnessing something you cannot explain.
Roam the out-of-the-way places at night and follow anything odd you see.
trophies.tip: Exact trigger not yet pinned down by the guides.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
steps: Perform a melee drive-by and bowl someone over.
Drive close, swing the melee attack from the vehicle, and connect.
trophies.tip: Exact trigger not yet pinned down by the guides — the description is the whole clue.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
steps: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts.
Marked bills come from robberies — keep a cut moving through your contacts instead of spending it raw.
The total is cumulative across the game.
trophies.tip: Robberies feed this directly; run it alongside Maximum Withdrawal.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, vehicles and upgrades all count.
The total is cumulative; big purchases late in the game finish it fast.
Save the biggest buys for after the story, when money is plentiful.
trophies.tip: Every dollar you spend while playing counts — this usually pops on its own.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida.
Properties appear for sale as you explore — check the map after each chapter.
Garages also store the vehicles you register for On the Spot.
trophies.tip: Save up during the story; garages are cheap next to late-game money.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
steps: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
Drive a vehicle, open the app and register it — each new model counts.
Use the garages from Little Boxes to keep the ones you want.
trophies.tip: Register as you discover vehicles for Whip It Good — two trophies, one drive.
